title: MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL on four Sparks
evidence_scope: DFlash5 draft, MXFP8 MoE and safetensors draft loader, on installer image dev-20260927-mimovision-cuda1342-nccl2323-status032: an installation through install.sh on one four-Spark ring, adopting the checkpoint copies on the Sparks, passed 7 of 7 functional checks (counting, arithmetic, code, tool calls, image, thinking) and a 256-request correctness screen with no degenerate response, and decoded 52.9 / 188 / 342 tokens/s at 1 / 8 / 16 streams at temperature 1.0 with 64K-token prefill at 4,076 tokens/s (performance/records/images/dev-20260927-mimovision-mimo-v26-flash-tp4-20260927.md); single-run timing; not serving-qualified. NCCL extended IPv4 GIDs, which the profile sets, prefilled 8K to 128K-token prompts 11-17% faster than with them off at an unchanged decode step rate (performance/records/images/dev-20260927-b12xcache-mimo-v26-20260927.md).
